agent_assumptions: F1 north windows (W1_N1-3) and F1 south large windows (W1_S2,W1_S3) share one window type; height/sill corrected to z=1.0-2.6m per North_view's own 400/1600/1000 dimension chain (distinct from the F2 800/1800/1000 chain that was previously mis-applied to F1).
F2 windows (North/South, z=4.0-5.8m) confirmed correct via matching 800/1800/1000 chains on North, South, East and West elevations.
F1 corridor window (W1_Ecorr, East) confirmed correct at z=1.0-2.8m via East_view's own 200/1800/1000 chain, distinct from the office-window chain.

F1 corridor window (W2 upper/ W1 lower) on West is a door (D1_Wcorr) not a window; West_view F1 block shows no vertical window dimension, consistent with a plain door opening, height assumed standard 2.1m (no explicit label).

South small transom window (W1_S_small, z=1.5-2.1m) and South F1 door (D1_main, z=0-2.1m) confirmed correct via South_view's 900/600/1500 (transom) and 900 head-gap (door, giving z-top=2.1m) readings.
F2 door heights (z=3.0-5.1m, i.e. 2.1m tall from F2 floor) remain an assumption mirroring F1 doors; no elevation shows F2 interior doors (interior, not on any facade).
unresolved: F2 bottom-row partition widths remain per original seed note (south elevation implies asymmetric ~5.31/2.19/2.19/5.31m vs modeled equal 3.75m) - not in this vertical-placement scope, left unresolved.
Closet/nook inside F1_R4 and exact interior door widths remain unresolved per seed.
F2 interior door heights (2.1m assumed) are not visible on any exterior elevation and remain an unverified assumption.
